dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: So far, I've taken care of quite a few hilichurls and slimes, but there's always more of them...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: They've been appearing more frequently of late. I cannot allow them to get any closer to Mondstadt. My lover Glory is...

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: ...No, it's nothing. Thanks for listening to me. Stay safe on your travels. Here's some of the experience I've gained out in the wild — I hope it'll be useful to you.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: I'm, uh... on an exploratory reconnaissance mission.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Do you need help with anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't think I've seen you in the city before.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Oh, you wouldn't have. I belong to an elite squadron of the Knights of Favonius, hand-picked by and reporting directly to Grand Master Varka himself. Our job is to be out there on the front line, defending Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: We are always called out on top-priority missions, so we hardly have time to hang about in the city.

dialogues.speaker: Godwin
dialogues.text: Speaking of which... Have you ever met a girl called Glory?

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: He is the current Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius. Of all the people in Mondstadt, he is the most deserving of our trust and admiration.

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: And that's not an overstatement. I am sure my fellow knights share my opinion.

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: For senior knights like us, there is nothing more glorious than to accompany the Grand Master himself on an expedition.

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: And I get to be part of just such a glorious expedition!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Where's the rest of the expedition party?

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: That's what I wanna know, too!

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: I... You see... The thing is...

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: *sigh* Forget it, I'm past the point of trying to save face...

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: As Grand Master Varka's expedition party was getting ready to leave Mondstadt, I—I lost a keepsake from Glory and then fell behind when they set off...

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: So now, as you can see, I've lost both the keepsake and the expedition party. I can't bring myself to go crawling back to Glory like this...

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: If you want to laugh at me, go ahead. A little laughter might make things more bearable.

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: Glory is the girl I love. She likes sitting on a bench, listening to the sound of the wind, and feeling the warmth of another body next to her's... That's what she said, anyway.

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: If you see her around the city, please...

response.speaker: Godwin
response.text: Ugh, never mind, there's no need to bother you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Well Godwin, you are an odd fellow. Goodbye.
